# Build tooling for the PyPI publish job (B6-07).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# --------------------
# .github/workflows/release-python.yml's `publish` job holds `id-token: write`, which is
# the PyPI Trusted Publishing credential. Anything that executes in that job can mint a
# PyPI token for `polaris-key`. It must therefore install ZERO unpinned code.
#
# `pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses to install anything that is not pinned with
# `==` AND accompanied by a hash it can verify, and it refuses if a transitive dependency
# is missing from this file. That turns "trust PyPI's resolver at publish time" into
# "trust exactly these bytes".
#
# The closure below is `build` + `hatchling` and their full runtime dependency sets as
# resolved for CPython 3.12 on Linux. `hatchling` is here because the publish job runs
# `python -m build --no-isolation`: with isolation, pip would silently fetch the backend
# (hatchling, from sdks/python/pyproject.toml's [build-system]) into a throwaway venv
# UNPINNED and UNHASHED, and run it — reintroducing the exact hole this file closes.
# Environment markers that are false on 3.12/Linux (colorama on Windows, tomli and
# importlib-metadata on older Pythons) are deliberately omitted.
#
# HOW TO REGENERATE
# -----------------
# Bump a version here only together with its hashes. Two equivalent ways to get them:
#
#   1. pip download --dest /tmp/pin --no-deps <pkg>==<version>
#      pip hash /tmp/pin/*
#
#   2. curl -sS https://pypi.org/pypi/<pkg>/json \
#        | jq -r '.releases["<version>"][] | .filename + " sha256:" + .digests.sha256'
#
# Both hashes per package (wheel and sdist) are listed; pip accepts a match against any
# one of them. All eight are pure-Python `py3-none-any` wheels, so the same artifact is
# used on every runner OS and the hashes are platform independent.
#
# Every hash below was verified by downloading the artifact and recomputing sha256 —
# not copied from a lockfile.
#
# Last regenerated: 2026-08-29

# --- `python -m build` frontend ------------------------------------------------------
